# Multi-stage build for a secure Node.js development sandbox
FROM node:22-bullseye AS base

# Install standard dev tools the LLM will expect
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    bash \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    vim \
    build-essential \
    python3 \
    make \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Create a non-root user for security
RUN useradd -m -s /bin/bash nodeuser

# Set up workspace directory
WORKDIR /home/nodeuser

# Copy package.json and package-lock.json if they exist (for your project)
# COPY package*.json ./ 2>/dev/null || true

# Install global packages that might be useful
RUN npm install -g \
    npm@latest \
    typescript@latest \
    eslint@latest \
    prettier@latest

# Set ownership of the workspace directory
RUN chown -R nodeuser:nodeuser /home/nodeuser

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodeuser

# Set up environment variables
ENV NODE_ENV=development
ENV PATH="/home/nodeuser/.npm-global/bin:${PATH}"

# Create .npmrc with safe defaults
RUN echo "prefix=${HOME}/.npm-global" > ~/.npmrc

# Keep the container alive with a simple command
CMD ["tail", "-f", "/dev/null"]
